stages.title: Aggregate demand (AD)
stages.sub: How to draw the AD curve and explain why it shifts.

steps.hint: Lower price, more quantity bought — does the line rise or fall as you move right?

steps.right: A downward-sloping line, like the individual demand curve

steps.q: Interest rates fall, homeowners feel wealthier, and consumption rises at every price level, not just at one point on the curve. Does the AD curve slide along itself, or does the whole curve move?
steps.right: The whole curve moves to a new position
steps.wrong: It slides along the same curve
steps.hint: The price level did not cause this change, a component of spending did. Does that change one point or every point on the curve?
